basic_profile.bio: Avid card game enthusiast hailing from Manchester, UK. By day, I work as a graphic designer, but my evenings are often spent strategizing new ways to optimize my Cardfight!! Vanguard decks. I have a soft spot for nostalgia, which is why I frequently visit Pokémon and retro gaming subreddits. I'm usually online late at night, often after midnight. I'm single and enjoy connecting with fellow card game and design enthusiasts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have been a fan of trading card games since childhood, starting with Pokémon and Yu-Gi-Oh!. Over the years, I've honed my knowledge through competitive play and community interaction. My graphics design background complements my interest in card aesthetics and deck customization.
